title: feat(desktop): give the editor a webcam layer model seeded from where the bubble was recorded (NIW2-573)
body:
PR 3 of the webcam-track stack ([#437 design](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/437) → [#441 recorder](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/441) → [#442 vault](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/442) → this). Linear [NIW2-573](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-573), parent [NIW2-565](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-565). Base: `feature/niw2-572-webcam-vault`.

## What this does

This PR gives the video editor a data model for the webcam layer; nothing draws it yet (that is #4). The model is `scene.webcam = { layout, segments } | null`. `layout` is the default look: shape, size, position, mirror, framing and shrink during zoom. `segments` are time ranges, anchored to the source, that hide the layer or override its layout. Opening a recording with a webcam seeds the layer from the bubble as it was recorded. To make that possible, main now writes the bubble's position and size into the sidecar when the take is finalized.

## Why

The preview (#4) and export (#5) both need one answer to "where is the webcam at time t". That answer is the pure function `webcamAt(scene, t)`, and it needs a model that saves, undoes and survives older and newer sessions.

## What changes for you

- **Nothing visible yet.** The editor saves a `webcam` key in `.edit.json` for recordings that have a webcam.
- **Sessions are more forgiving.** An invalid webcam part in a saved session now drops only that part, never the cuts, zooms or redactions. A zoom or webcam segment dragged to exactly its minimum length no longer fails to load because of a float rounding error. The zoom part was a defect that already existed, fixed here because it is the same line.
- **The sidecar of new camera takes gains `recordedLayout.position` and `sizeFraction`.**

## What to review

1. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/session.ts:435`: `validateWebcam` and its callers.** A bad layer becomes `null` and a bad segment is dropped, so the session always loads. Decide whether dropping is right, or whether a bad segment should be clamped instead. Either way, `reconcileWebcam` re-seeds a dropped layer from the sidecar.
2. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-reuse.ts:53`: the fingerprint leaves out `webcam: null`.** Exports from recordings without a webcam keep their old hash, so they stay reusable. A recording with a webcam hashes its layer. Note: nothing burns the face in yet, so the export PR must bump `ENCODE_REVISION` (recorded on NIW2-575).
3. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:417`: `withRecordedBubble` at finalize.** The bubble's center is in global DIP, normalized to the recorded rectangle (the area or the display). A window take records nothing, and a hidden bubble records nothing. A position sent by the renderer is ignored. The position is read at the end of the take, so if the bubble moved during the take, the layer seeds where it ended.
4. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/scene.ts:151`: `reconcileWebcam`.** The sidecar decides whether a layer exists. A saved layer is dropped while the webcam file is missing (follow-up W3).

**Safe to skim:** `webcam-edits.ts` and its tests (pure functions that return the same scene on a no-op), the plumbing through `library/types.ts`, `map-item.ts` and `open-in-editor.ts`, and `area-geometry.ts` (a pure helper, tested).

## Proof

| Criterion (NIW2-573) | What was done | How to check it | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scene.webcam = { layout, segments } \| null`, additive in session v1; old builds ignore the key | New key, no version bump | `session.test.ts` "webcam layer" | Unit tests pass. Codex and Opus each read the old parser: it ignores unknown keys |
| `parseSession` validates and clamps; segments source-anchored, sorted, non-overlapping, `hidden`/`override` | `validateWebcam*`; bad parts dropped, not fatal | `session.test.ts`: clamps, sorting, overlaps, invalid layer → `null` with zooms kept, invalid segment dropped | Unit tests pass |
| Seeds from the recorded bubble; `webcam: null` without one | `seedWebcamScene`, `initialScene(…, webcam)`, `reconcileWebcam` | `webcam-model.test.ts` "seedWebcamScene"; `scene.test.ts` "initialScene — webcam", "reconcileWebcam" | Unit tests pass |
| Undo/redo covers webcam edits; pure edit operations | `webcam-edits.ts` through `use-video-scene` history | `webcam-edits.test.ts`; `use-video-scene.test.ts` "webcam edits" | Unit tests pass |
| Pure `webcamAt(scene, t)` | Merges the override over the layout; `null` while hidden | `webcam-model.test.ts` "webcamAt" | Unit tests pass |
| The bubble position is recorded at finalize | `withRecordedBubble`, `bubblePlacementInRect` | `recording-hub.test.ts` "the bubble's position is recorded at finalize" (area, display, hidden + forged position, window); `area-geometry.test.ts` | Unit tests pass. **Real window bounds not observed** |
| check-types, lint and tests pass | — | `vitest run`; pre-push `verify:local` | exit 0, 314 files, 3111 tests; pre-push passed |

## Decisions

- **The bubble's position and size are recorded in main at finalize**, not in the renderer. Main has the window bounds and the recorded rectangle; the renderer has neither. A position sent by the renderer is stripped.
- **Size is stored as `sizeFraction`** (the visible side over the recorded height). The spec derived it from pixels, but bubble sizes are in DIP and the scale factor is not stored. Older takes fall back to the DIP size over a nominal 1080.
- **The position is where the bubble sat at the end of the take.** Options: the first position, the last, or a timeline of positions. Taken: the last; it is the simplest, and the layer is draggable in #4.
- **Invalid webcam data is dropped, never fatal to the session** (review W1). Losing a layout costs one re-seed; losing a session costs the user's edits.
- **The `scaleDuringZoom` range is 0.3–1 and size is 0.1–0.6 of the output height.** The spec gave no range for the first.
- **The minimum segment length is checked with a 1e-6 tolerance**, for zooms too (review W2).

## Review ledger

> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Changes the persisted session schema (`session.ts`), the export reuse fingerprint (`export-reuse.ts`), shared types (`webcam-track.ts`) and the main process's recording finalize (`recording-hub.ts`).

| id | severity | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W1 | should | fixed: cabc6419 (an invalid layer becomes `null`, an invalid segment is dropped, the session always loads) |
| W2 | should | fixed: 4fd4de5f (min-length tolerance for webcam and zoom segments) |
| W5 | nit | fixed: 5efa2953 (the off-editor stamp check reconciles before fingerprinting) |
| W3 | nit | declined, follow-up: keep the saved layer while the webcam file is missing; needs a "meta but file missing" signal |
| W4 | nit | deferred to NIW2-575: bump `ENCODE_REVISION` when exports start drawing the webcam |
| W6 | nit | declined, follow-up: a loader integration test, and a pre-PR session fixture |

Rounds: 2 with Opus 5.5 (fresh-context reviewer) and 1 with Codex (cross-provider, read-only: APPROVE, no findings). Budget 5.
**Verdict for 62e4fc23 (patch-id 69cef7c776c7): approved, only nits remain.** (Opus re-checked 62e4fc23, the agent-review fixes.)

## Checks

- `cd apps/kaipu-record && vitest run`: exit 0, 314 files, 3111 tests passed (on 5efa2953).
- Pre-push `verify:local` (lint, oxfmt, build, check-types): passed on push.

## Manual verification

This is owner QA; agents do not run Electron on the owner's machine.

**Setup:** `git checkout feature/niw2-573-webcam-scene && bun install && bun run dev`.

**1. The recorded position**
- Record 5 s with the camera on and the bubble in a corner of an area.
- Open `<vault>/.kaipu/<id>.json`.
- Expect: `webcam.recordedLayout.position` is about `{x: 0.1, y: 0.85}` for bottom-left, and `sizeFraction` is between 0 and 1.
- Broken if: there is no `position`, or it is outside 0–1.

**2. The seeded session**
- Open that recording in the editor, make any edit (a trim) so it autosaves, then open `.kaipu/<id>.edit.json`.
- Expect: a `webcam` key with the layout above and `segments: []`.

**3. An old recording**
- Open one made before #441 and edit it.
- Expect: no `webcam` key in its `.edit.json`, and its zooms and cuts behave as before.

## What I did not verify

- The real bubble's window bounds, multi-display takes, and a bubble dragged during the take.
- How an old build behaves with a new session: verified by reading only (the parser ignores unknown keys), not by running an old build.
